# demography

The R package `demography` provides functions for demographic analysis
including: lifetable calculations; Lee-Carter modelling; functional data
analysis of mortality rates, fertility rates, net migration numbers; and
stochastic population forecasting.

## Installation

You can install the **stable** version on [R
CRAN](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=demography).

``` r

install.packages('demography', dependencies = TRUE)
```

You can also install the **development** version from
[Github](https://github.com/robjhyndman/demography)

``` r

# install.packages("devtools")
library(devtools)
install_github("robjhyndman/demography")
```

## License

This package is free and open source software, licensed under GPL (\>=

# Package index

## All functions

- [`as.data.frame(`*`<demogdata>`*`)`](as.data.frame.demogdata.md) :
  Coerce a demogdata object to a data.frame object
- [`aus.fert`](ausfert.md) : Australian fertility data
- [`cm.spline()`](cm.spline.md) [`cm.splinefun()`](cm.spline.md) :
  Monotonic interpolating splines
- [`coherentfdm()`](coherentfdm.md) : Coherent functional demographic
  model for grouped data
- [`combine.demogdata()`](combine.demogdata.md) : Combine two demogdata
  objects into one demogdata object
- [`compare.demogdata()`](compare.demogdata.md) : Evaluation of
  demographic forecast accuracy
- [`demogdata()`](demogdata.md) : Create demogdata object from raw data
  matrices
- [`extract.ages()`](extract.ages.md) : Extract some ages from a
  demogdata object
- [`extract.years()`](extract.years.md) : Extract some years from a
  demogdata object
- [`fdm()`](fdm.md) : Functional demographic model
- [`forecast(`*`<fdm>`*`)`](forecast.fdm.md) : Forecast functional
  demographic model.
- [`forecast(`*`<fdmpr>`*`)`](forecast.fdmpr.md) : Forecast coherent
  functional demographic model.
- [`forecast(`*`<lca>`*`)`](forecast.lca.md) : Forecast demogdata data
  using Lee-Carter method.
- [`fr.mort`](fr.mort.md) [`fr.sm`](fr.mort.md) : French mortality data
- [`hmd.mx()`](hmd.md) [`hmd.e0()`](hmd.md) [`hmd.pop()`](hmd.md) : Read
  data from HMD and construct a mortality demogdata object
- [`isfe()`](isfe.md) : Integrated Squared Forecast Error for models of
  various orders
- [`lca()`](lca.md) [`bms()`](lca.md) : Model mortality or fertility
  data using Lee-Carter approach
- [`life.expectancy()`](life.expectancy.md)
  [`flife.expectancy()`](life.expectancy.md)
  [`e0()`](life.expectancy.md) : Estimate life expectancy from mortality
  rates
- [`lifetable()`](lifetable.md) : Construct lifetables from mortality
  rates
- [`mean(`*`<demogdata>`*`)`](mean.demogdata.md)
  [`median(`*`<demogdata>`*`)`](mean.demogdata.md) : Mean and median
  functions for data of class demogdata
- [`netmigration()`](migration.md) : Calculate net migration from
  mortality and fertility data
- [`models()`](models.md) : Show model information for the forecast
  coefficients in FDM models.
- [`plot(`*`<demogdata>`*`)`](plot.demogdata.md)
  [`lines(`*`<demogdata>`*`)`](plot.demogdata.md)
  [`points(`*`<demogdata>`*`)`](plot.demogdata.md) : Plot age-specific
  demographic functions
- [`plot(`*`<errorfdm>`*`)`](plot.errorfdm.md) : Plot differences
  between actuals and estimates from fitted demographic model
- [`plot(`*`<fmforecast>`*`)`](plot.fmforecast.md)
  [`plot(`*`<lca>`*`)`](plot.fmforecast.md) : Plot forecasts from a
  functional demographic modell
- [`plot(`*`<lifetable>`*`)`](plot.lifetable.md)
  [`lines(`*`<lifetable>`*`)`](plot.lifetable.md) : Plot life expectancy
  from lifetable
- [`pop.sim()`](pop.sim.md) : Population simulation
- [`read.demogdata()`](read.demogdata.md) : Read demographic data and
  construct demogdata object
- [`residuals(`*`<fdm>`*`)`](residuals.fdm.md)
  [`fitted(`*`<fdm>`*`)`](residuals.fdm.md)
  [`fitted(`*`<lca>`*`)`](residuals.fdm.md)
  [`residuals(`*`<lca>`*`)`](residuals.fdm.md) : Compute residuals and
  fitted values from functional demographic model or Lee-Carter model
- [`set.upperage()`](set.upperage.md) : Combine the upperages of a
  demogdata object.
- [`sex.ratio()`](sex.ratio.md) : Compute sex ratios from mortality
  rates
- [`simulate(`*`<fmforecast>`*`)`](simulate.fmforecast.md)
  [`simulate(`*`<fmforecast2>`*`)`](simulate.fmforecast.md) : Simulate
  future sample paths from functional demographic model forecasts.
- [`smooth.demogdata()`](smooth.demogdata.md) : Create smooth demogdata
  functions
- [`summary(`*`<fdm>`*`)`](summary.fdm.md)
  [`summary(`*`<lca>`*`)`](summary.fdm.md) : Summary for functional
  demographic model or Lee-Carter model
- [`tfr()`](tfr.md) : Compute total fertility rate from fertility rates
- [`update(`*`<fmforecast>`*`)`](update.md)
  [`update(`*`<fmforecast2>`*`)`](update.md) : Updating functional
  demographic models and coherent functional demographic models.
